hero.title: Kesariya: A Royal Culinary Journey Through Rajasthan
hero.subtitle: Experience the authentic, rich flavors and grand traditions of India's desert state, right here in Bangalore.

about.title: The Story Behind Kesariya
about.paragraph1: At Kesariya, we proudly bring the royal and rich flavors of Rajasthan directly to your table. Our commitment is to an authentic traditional dining experience, where every dish is crafted with passion, using fresh, high-quality ingredients and centuries-old recipes. We invite you to savor the culinary heritage of India's desert state, delivered with unparalleled warmth and hospitality.
about.paragraph2: More than just a meal, dining at Kesariya is an immersion into the grandeur of Rajasthan. Our ambiance is thoughtfully designed to reflect the state's majestic heritage, creating a welcoming and sophisticated setting. From our meticulously prepared Thalis to our signature Lall Maas, each visit promises a journey for your senses, celebrating the true spirit of Rajasthani culinary excellence.
